title: Control & Reporting Asst Analyst
description:
**Overview**
 To provide end\-to\-end control, governance, and analytical support for the Agro Business in Kolkata, West Bengal. This role focuses on strengthening existing processes, driving automation initiatives, and ensuring robust governance across Seed\-to\-Chip and Seed\-to\-Seed operations. The role will actively contribute to central automation projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Control, Governance \& Risk
* Drive the Agro control agenda and establish a robust control framework in the Kolkata region.
* Participate in risk assessments, define and implement business control activities (BCAs), and monitor effectiveness in the field.
* Ensure compliance with GCS, Schedule of Authority, and internal governance standards.
* Track and close control gaps, audit observations, and process deviations.
* Financial Reporting \& Month\-End Close
* Ensure Day\-0 month\-end close with accurate books and timely submission.
* Manage provisions and accruals for shrinkage, rottage, warehouses, MOH, freight, and other Agro costs.
* Review seed costing, inventory accounting, and GIT, highlighting risks and corrective actions.
* Support reconciliations and periodic financial reporting.
* Management Reporting \& Performance Reviews
* Prepare, validate, and consolidate Agro KPI reports with variance analysis and business insights.
* Drive performance reviews with Agro teams (Potato and Seed).
* Collate and validate data for regional reviews and leadership updates.
* Inventory, Assets \& Field Controls
* Ensure accurate representation of stock and assets through monthly balance sheet reviews and physical verification.
* Monitor seed pipeline, inventory movements, and warehouse/cold store governance.
* Conduct regular site visits to warehouses and fields to ensure adherence to processes and controls.
* Statutory Compliance \& Audits
* Ensure compliance with local statutory requirements, including Mandi taxes and filing of returns.
* Ensure availability and compliance of Seed, Potato, and other Agro licenses in coordination with Legal.
* Coordinate internal, statutory, and other audits, and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Business Partnering \& Operations Support
* Anchor contract farming and storage agreements, including validation, approvals, and due diligence.
* Support cold store due diligence and opening in SAP, seasonal setup, and operational readiness.
* Support transporter contracting and related commercial processes.
* Coordinate cross\-functional Agro initiatives such as modernization projects, bulk cold stores, and cross\-freight.
* Process Setup, Automation \& Training
* Drive central automation projects and reduction of manual interventions.
* Design and implement relevant SOPs and control processes for the region.


 Conduct training and hand\-holding for plant and field teams on finance, controls, and compliance.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Education \& Experience
   

  

* CA with 3–4 years of experience in Finance / Controllership roles.
* Strong hands\-on exposure to month\-end close, provisions, balance sheet reviews, and inventory accounting in a manufacturing or supply\-chain environment.
* Working knowledge of internal controls and ERP systems (SAP preferred).
* Ability to work independently and partner closely with operations.
* Preferred: Exposure to Agro, FMCG, or Agri\-supply chain businesses.


 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong control mindset with ability to design practical processes, supported by analytical and MIS skills with clear variance analysis.
* High ownership with effective stakeholder management across field, plant, and regional teams.
* Willingness to travel to warehouses, cold stores, and field locations as required.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Location: Corporate Headquarters, Kolkata
 



 Reporting to: President \& Chief Sales \& Marketing Officer
 



 Function: Business Analyst \| Business Intelligence \| MIS
 



  





 SRMB Group is seeking an accomplished Business Analytics and MIS leader to create a single, trusted commercial view across our national sales organization.
 



  





 SRMB is a 75\+ year\-old, Kolkata\-headquartered steel and construction materials group with a turnover exceeding ₹2,500 crore, more than 3,000 employees, a strong manufacturing base in Eastern India, and an extensive dealer and distributor network.
 



  





 As SRMB prepares for its next phase of growth, we are strengthening data\-led commercial governance, technology adoption and management decision\-making. This is a high\-impact leadership role working closely with the President \& CSMO and senior business leadership.
 



  





**THE MANDATE** 




 The GM – Business Analytics \& MIS will lead the consolidation, governance and analysis of Sales and Marketing information across retail TMT, structural steel, project and institutional businesses.
 



 The individual will integrate primary and secondary sales, dispatch, collections, inventory, dealer, product, market, scheme and sales\-funnel data into reliable dashboards and decision\-ready insights.
 



  





 This is not merely a report\-generation role. We are looking for someone who can convert complex commercial data into clear business actions, challenge inconsistent numbers and build reporting discipline across a large, multi\-zone sales organization.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





 • Establish a single source of truth for Sales and Marketing data, KPIs and management reporting.
 



 • Own the daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly sales MIS calendar across dispatch, sales achievement, collections, inventory, dealer and SKU performance, schemes, market share and pipeline.
 



 • Reconcile information across ERP, CRM, SFA, DMS, Finance, dispatch and other business systems, ensuring accuracy and traceability.
 



 • Build and govern Power BI and advanced Excel dashboards with drill\-downs, alerts, exception reporting and clear action ownership.
 



 • Generate actionable insights on growth, volume, price–mix, contribution, dealer health, channel productivity, territory whitespace, customer retention, competitive movement and market opportunities.
 



 • Support annual and quarterly target setting across zones, territories, channels, dealers, sales personnel and product categories.
 



 • Strengthen sales forecasting and S\&OP through analysis of historical trends, order pipelines, seasonality, channel inventory, dispatch capacity and market intelligence.
 



 • Evaluate dealer and distributor performance, scheme effectiveness, sales\-funnel conversion, collection risks and working\-capital indicators.
 



 • Improve adoption and data discipline across CRM, SFA, DMS and related sales\-technology platforms.
 



 • Prepare decision\-oriented reviews and executive insight packs for the President \& CSMO and senior leadership.
 



 • Establish SOPs, reporting controls, review mechanisms, action trackers and escalation protocols.
 



 • Automate repetitive reporting, eliminate parallel or ungoverned trackers and develop a prioritised commercial analytics roadmap.
 



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 




 • 10–15 years of relevant experience in Sales MIS, business intelligence, commercial analytics, sales planning or a related function. Exceptional candidates with 8\+ years of substantial independent ownership may also be considered.
 



 • Strong preference for experience in steel, cement, building materials, industrial products or another B2B business operating through a large dealer/distributor and multi\-zone network.
 



 • MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Finance, Operations or Business Analytics preferred. Strong candidates with backgrounds in Engineering, Statistics, Economics or Commerce may also be considered.
 



 • Advanced hands\-on capability in Excel, including Power Query and Power Pivot, and strong proficiency in Power BI or Tableau.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for ambitious and analytical minds to join our Data team as a
 **Data Analyst for Consumer Spend Research** 
 . This is not a conventional reporting role. You will analyse US consumer credit card spend data, research and classify brands and merchants, and map them accurately to create insights and analytical reports. Alongside that analytical work, you will spend a significant part of your time building and maintaining the pipelines that move and shape that data, working with senior data engineers, data scientists and analysts to turn raw transaction data into reliable, analysis\-ready datasets.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines a genuinely critical eye for data with strong Python and SQL skills, curiosity about cloud data infrastructure, and comfort with modern development practices including AI\-assisted coding and version control. You will be given real ownership early and supported by an experienced team.
   

  

**Location** 
 : Kolkata (Rajarhat, New Town)
   

  

**Experience Level** 
 : 1\-3 years
   

  

**Timing:** 
 Ability to work in the US Eastern time zone. This may be relaxed to half day IST and half day US EST, based on project needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Consumer spend research and analysis**
* Analyse US consumer credit card spend data, identifying patterns, anomalies and variations that are not obvious at first glance.
* Research brands and merchants online and map transaction data to the correct entities with a high standard of accuracy.
* Conduct online research across search engines, directories and unconventional sources to resolve ambiguous or incomplete records.
* Produce clear, well\-written analytical reports and insight summaries for client\-side stakeholders.
* Perform exploratory analysis to investigate data discrepancies, identify trends and support decision\-making by product and business teams.


**Data engineering and pipeline work**
* Build and maintain ETL and ELT scripts and data transformation logic in Python and SQL, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Write clean, tested, well\-documented Python for data ingestion, cleaning, validation and enrichment across multiple source systems.
* Support the development and monitoring of data workflows orchestrated with Apache Airflow, including troubleshooting failed runs.
* Work with AWS data services including S3, Glue, Athena and Redshift to move, store and query data at scale.
* Write and optimise complex SQL queries, and use regular expressions to filter, classify and clean large volumes of transaction data.
* Implement and run data quality checks, reconciliation routines and alerting so issues are caught before they reach downstream consume


**Ways of working**
* Use AI\-powered coding assistants and IDE integrations such as Kiro to accelerate development, code review and documentation.
* Follow version control and code review practices using Git.
* Apply data governance, security and access\-control standards consistently across all work.
* Document pipelines, data definitions, classification rules and analysis methods so the team can rely on and extend your work.


 ‍
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Graduate in any discipline. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics or a related field is preferred, as is exposure to market research or data analytics.
* 1 to 3 years of professional experience in data analysis, data engineering, market research or a closely related role.
* Strong proficiency in Python for data work, including pandas, and the ability to write production\-quality scripts rather than notebook\-only code.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, window functions, aggregations and query optimisation.
* Working knowledge of regular expressions for pattern matching and data classification. This is mandatory.
* Working exposure to AWS, covering services such as S3, Glue, Athena and Redshift.
* Understanding of ETL and ELT concepts, data modelling fundamentals and relational database design.
* Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI\-assisted development tools within modern IDEs for prototyping, code generation, testing and debugging.
* Software literacy: able to learn new programs quickly and comfortable navigating unfamiliar interfaces and expressions.
* A critical eye: able to think laterally to find sources of information that help distinguish variations in data that look identical at first glance.
* Online research capability: comfortable navigating web pages, search engines, directories and unconventional sources.
* Excellent reading and writing: can process and produce long or complex alphanumeric strings, both abstract and functional, with ease and accuracy.
* Excellent communication: can clearly explain how and why decisions were made, and can take and act on constructive feedback.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
* Good written and spoken English, with the confidence to work directly with client\-side stakeholders.


 ‍
   

  

**Good To Have**
* Hands\-on exposure to Apache Airflow or a comparable orchestration tool.
* Experience with data annotation, taxonomy building or other forms of data markup.
* Exposure to machine learning or LLM workflows, or to supporting data scientists with feature preparation.
* Prior experience working with US market data or financial transaction data.
* Residence within one hour of travel to the office.

title: Technofunctional Consultant (Business Analyst)
description:
Zuneko \| Kolkata \& Client Sites \| Full\-time
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We build digital transformations for Indian SMEs and enterprises. Most engagements are ERP implementations on the Frappe / ERPNext stack. Many of our clients already run on SAP or Tally, so the work typically involves integrating ERPNext with those systems, and in some cases migrating off them entirely. Other engagements involve custom software, AI applications and automation tools, or computer vision deployments. This role sits at the centre of all of it. You understand the client's business, translate it into system logic, and see it through to a live, adopted solution.
 



 If you know ERPNext, great. If you know ERP but not ERPNext (SAP, Zoho, Odoo, or similar), we'll teach you Frappe, and you will learn our custom software, AI, and computer vision offerings on the job. What we can't teach is business sense, ownership, the ability to bring order to messy organisations, and the instinct to design systems that keep working as a client's business scales.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Discovery \& Scoping
 


* Frequent client sites to understand how their business actually runs
* Map processes across Finance, Purchase, Logistics, Sales, HR, and Operations
* Identify gaps between current state and target capability, and assess whether the right answer is ERP configuration, custom software, AI automation, a computer vision use case, or a combination
* Produce scoping documents, FRDs, process maps, and user stories



 Design \& Development Liaison
 


* Translate business requirements into solution designs: modules, workflows, roles, permissions, and reports for ERP engagements; functional specifications, logic flows, and acceptance criteria for custom software, AI tools, and computer vision use cases
* Act as the single point of contact between client teams and our ERP, software, AI, and computer vision developers
* Conduct real\-time requirement and feedback gathering at client sites to facilitate design thinking
* Co\-design solution approaches with the dev team, validate feasibility, and continuously refine system logic, with an eye on how the design holds up as data, users, and complexity grow



 Implementation \& Go\-Live
 


* Configure ERPNext end\-to\-end: masters, chart of accounts, taxation, pricing rules, communication integrations, multi\-company / multi\-branch setups
* Scope and coordinate integrations between ERPNext and the client's existing SAP, Tally, or other systems, ensuring clean data flow and reconciliation across both
* Manage data migration from Tally, SAP, Excel, and other legacy systems where a client is transitioning fully to ERPNext
* For custom software, AI, and computer vision engagements, coordinate deployment, integration with the client's existing systems, and on\-ground readiness such as data availability, access, and camera or hardware setups
* Own UAT: write test cases, track defects, enforce sign\-offs
* Plan and execute go\-live activities including rollback strategies
* Provide on\-site hypercare post\-launch to ensure operational continuity



 Training \& Adoption
 


* Train end users on implemented solutions across client departments, whether ERP, custom software, AI tools, or computer vision systems
* Build documentation that supports smooth adoption
* Collect structured feedback post\-deployment and drive continuous improvement in an agile manner



 Presales \& Sales Support
 


* Visit prospective client sites (including government offices where relevant) to assist in pitching our ERP, custom software, AI, and computer vision capabilities
* Support presales conversations by understanding client pain points and mapping them to the most relevant solution
* Follow up with prospects post\-meeting and maintain relationships until a decision is made
* Once a client is onboarded, transition into the BA role and own the implementation end\-to\-end



 Client Relationships \& Account Growth
 


* Serve as our frontline B2B relationship owner at client sites
* Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and upsell or cross\-sell across Zuneko's capabilities
* Maintain strong stakeholder trust throughout the engagement lifecycle



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 Must\-haves
 


* 2 to 6 years of experience in similar roles: ERP or software implementations as a Business Analyst, Techno\-Functional Consultant, or equivalent
* Technical background (B.Tech, B.Sc, BCA, etc.) or proven technical expertise
* Strong grasp of core business functions, including P2P, O2C, R2R, payroll, approval workflows, and accounting across departments
* Strong grasp of business logic: how workflows, approvals, and data actually connect across departments, not just how individual screens or features behave in isolation
* Fluency with Tally and Excel, and working familiarity with SAP, since most clients run on these and our implementations typically integrate with or migrate from them
* Prior exposure to ERP, SaaS, or system rollout implementations on any platform (ERPNext, SAP Business One, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, Zoho, or similar)
* Enough technical understanding of AI tools, automation, and computer vision systems to scope requirements, explain solutions credibly to clients, and brief developers accurately
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems into clear workflows and process maps, not just gather requirements
* Ability to design and scope systems that scale, thinking beyond the immediate ask to how workflows, data models, and processes will hold up as a client's transaction volume, users, and complexity grow
* Comfort working in low\-process, high\-ambiguity SME environments and imposing structure
* Ability to challenge client assumptions and avoid over\-customisation while maintaining stakeholder buy\-in
* Working understanding of how systems translate to data models (tables, relationships, dependencies) without needing to code
* Experience with documentation standards: FRDs, BRDs, user stories, test cases
* Strong UAT ownership: ability to define success criteria and enforce sign\-offs
* Excellent communication skills across senior management and ground\-level staff
* High ownership and responsiveness when managing multiple stakeholders and moving priorities



  





 Good to have
 


* Prior implementation experience with ERPNext / Frappe, or with other ERP platforms such as SAP (Business One / ECC), Zoho (Books / One), or Odoo; training on Frappe / ERPNext will be provided either way
* Experience with ERP\-to\-ERP or ERP\-to\-accounting integrations (for example, ERPNext with Tally or SAP)
* Hands\-on exposure to custom software, AI, automation, or computer vision projects in a client\-facing or implementation capacity
* Knowledge of Indian statutory and taxation frameworks (GST, TDS, etc.)
* Familiarity with agile and design thinking methodologies
* Prior experience with SME digital transformation projects
* Comfortable with frequent travel to client sites across Kolkata and nearby regions with extended on\-site presence during active project phases (expenses covered)

* Verify the identity of clients to understand the nature and purpose of their relationship with the financial institution for the purposes of performing Know your Customer (KYC) Procedures.
* Interpret and implement client\-operating policies regarding financial data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 Normal Working Hours and Conditions
   

  

 Core business hours are generally 8:00 am – 5:00 pm. However, this position may require work to be performed outside of the core business hours based on Company operations across different time zones.
   

  

**Physical Requirements**
 Primary functions require sufficient physical ability and mobility to work in office setting; to stand or sit for prolonged periods of time; to work at a computer for a minimum of eight hours; to occasionally stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; to lift, carry, push, and/or pull light to moderate amounts of weight.; to operate office equipment requiring repetitive hand movement and fine coordination including use of a computer keyboard and mouse; to travel to other office locations and to communicate with others.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Customer Centricity
   

  

* Put the customer’s voice at the center of all decision\-making.
* Ask ourselves “will this benefit the customer?” before making any decisions.
* Use our expertise to guide and support our customer to achieve their goals.
* Work with other functions and teams to drive business performance with our customers.


 ACT Feedback Model
   

  

* Before giving feedback, be clear on how a specific behavior change will help the individual or the company. Giving feedback to get frustration off your chest or intentionally hurt the other person is not tolerated.
* Be precise in giving or receiving feedback so that specific inputs can lead to better outcomes.

description:
**Role Title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field
* Proven analytical and decision\-making skills
* Experience developing scoring models or decision\-tree segmentations
* Ability to independently manage processes, Self\-motivated, and drive continuous process improvement

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. title: Senior Power BI Engineer
description:
We are building a centralised marketing and sales analytics platform for a large multi\-market consumer brand: a governed BigQuery data layer feeding a single, certified Power BI reporting product used by head\-office marketing and sales teams and by every national market. It replaces a fragmented estate of hand\-built, per\-market dashboards and manual spreadsheet exports with one version of the truth.
   

  

 You will own the Power BI half of that platform end to end — the semantic model, the KPI logic, every report page, and the executive PDF report generated from it. This is not a dashboard\-assembly role. One model and one report template must serve every market through filtering, hold up under executive scrutiny, and reconcile to source platforms on demand.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 6\+ Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Onsite)
   

  

**‍Key Responsibilities**
 ‍
   

  

**Strategic Marketing \& Brand Building**
* Design, build and own the certified Power BI semantic model over a governed star schema in the cloud warehouse — relationships, cardinality, role\-playing dates, hierarchies and field\-level documentation.
* Choose and justify the connectivity approach (Import, DirectQuery or composite), and implement incremental refresh, aggregations and partitioning to keep refresh windows and query response inside agreed service levels.
* Author the KPI layer in DAX: a frozen, documented catalogue of measures covering traffic, engagement, conversion and funnel performance, with consistent year\-on\-year, year\-to\-date, quarter\-on\-quarter and custom period\-comparison logic.
* Implement weighted and normalised benchmark measures so small and large markets can be compared fairly against a group average.
* Keep the model performant and maintainable — calculation groups, variables, disciplined measure structure, and regular tuning with Performance Analyzer, DAX Studio and Tabular Editor.


 ‍
   

  

**Report And Experience Design**
* Build the report pages the business actually asked for: a real\-time KPI tracker with progress\-to\-target visuals, market\-versus\-group benchmarking, product\-level performance, an end\-to\-end lead\-to\-order funnel with banded performance thresholds, channel and traffic\-source analysis, and social performance.
* Design for flexible self\-service: independent metric selection per visual, multi\-market comparison, switchable chart types, and free choice of reporting and comparison periods — without users needing to export anything.
* Apply a consistent, accessible visual language across every page: clear labelling, sensible visual hierarchy, and charts rather than dense tables.
* Configure workspaces, apps, audiences and deployment pipelines across development, test and production, and implement row\-level security where required.


 ‍
   

  

**Executive reporting layer**
* Build and automate the recurring executive PDF report generated directly from the platform, using paginated reports and export automation, so a market or period can be selected and a complete, correctly formatted pack produced in one action.
* Ensure exported visuals remain visuals — presentation\-ready output, not screenshots of tables.


 ‍
   

  

**Quality, reconciliation and trust**
* Build data quality and anomaly surfacing into the reporting layer: freshness indicators, missing\-period detection, and outlier alerting on unexpected drops or spikes.
* Reconcile platform figures against the underlying source platforms, document the variances that are structurally expected, and explain them clearly to non\-technical stakeholders before they are discovered in a meeting.
* Write and maintain the model and report documentation, KPI definitions and handover material.


 ‍
   

  

**Delivery**
* Work to a gated, fixed\-scope delivery plan with hard go\-live dates, translating business requirements into agreed KPI definitions and report specifications.
* Run user acceptance testing on a reference market, manage a controlled review\-and\-revision cycle per report page, and support training and handover.


 ‍
   

  

**‍Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 6\+ years in business intelligence or analytics engineering, with at least 4 years hands\-on in Power BI on production, business\-critical reporting.
* Advanced DAX — time intelligence, calculation groups, context transition, performance\-conscious measure design. You can explain why a measure is slow, not just that it is.
* Proven semantic model design over a dimensional warehouse: star schema, incremental refresh, composite models, aggregations, gateways and capacity considerations.
* Strong SQL, and practical experience querying a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Redshift or Synapse considered) with an understanding of partitioning, clustering and query cost.
* Direct experience modelling digital analytics data — particularly GA4 event\-level exports in a warehouse, including nested and repeated structures, sessionisation and conversion definitions. This is the single most important differentiator for this role.
* Paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder / RDL) and export automation for pixel\-accurate PDF output.
* Report and dashboard design judgement — you can take a vague executive requirement and produce something that answers it in seconds, and you can defend your layout decisions.
* Power Query / M for shaping and troubleshooting, and comfort with source\-control and deployment discipline.
* Confident written and spoken English, and the composure to present work directly to senior stakeholders and take feedback in the room.


 ‍
   

  

**Desirable**
* Marketing, media or e\-commerce measurement background — an understanding of what marketers and sales leadership actually need to see.
* Working knowledge of consent management and its effect on reported figures, and how modelled data behaves differently across interfaces and warehouse exports.
* Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Premium / Fabric capacity administration.
* Multi\-market or multi\-tenant reporting at scale, including row\-level security design.
* dbt or an equivalent transformation framework; Python for supporting automation.
* Custom or advanced visuals (for example Deneb / Vega\-Lite) where the standard library falls short.
* Relevant Microsoft certification (PL\-300 or equivalent) — useful, but the portfolio matters more.


 ‍
   

  

**Interview Process**
* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* ‍Role match \& offer

title: TD- PM Solutions Senior- Non-US
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Transformation Delivery – Senior Consultant**
 The Transformation Delivery practice @ EY provides a rewarding career opportunity, targeted toward becoming a professional in complex business, technology and infrastructure transformation, not simply being a generalist. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in today’s marketplace, come join our dynamic TD\&E team!
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Our clients are seeking and hiring a new type of Transformation Delivery expert – one who provides strategic guidance but is also deeply embedded in the delivery and success of their programs. Traditional suppliers, such as strategy houses, systems integrators and engineering project management consultants, cannot provide the complete service our clients now demand. Our insights and capabilities across all portfolio levels in planning, analysis and delivery are integrated into our core offerings, and this exemplifies our unique viewpoint over traditional program management. We also offer services that focus on 'bridging the gap’ between execution and strategy primarily by designing and implementing frameworks and solutions that allow companies to make data\-driven decisions to optimize and manage portfolios and programs/projects. With digital transformations being a focus of EY, we have incorporated technology into our processes, automating manual work and enabling us to provide greater insights and value to our clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 A successful Transformation Design and Execution Senior will work with our clients to design and establish Transformation Management Office (TMO), Program Management Office (PMO) or Project Portfolio Management business processes and solutions to manage high profile complex programs by applying proven EY frameworks and methodologies based on industry recognized global standards.
   

  

 You will partner with engagement leadership to design and establish core processes and support a delivery team in planning, controlling, and executing complex programs, PMO’s and Transformation Offices. In your role, you will gain valuable insights and help drive strategic conversations with key stakeholders.
   

  

 You will also work closely with our Technology Solutions team to creatively leverage technology to support processes as part of the overall solution design.
   

  

 Key deliverables that you will work on are:
   

  

* Assessments and Process Design
* Roadmap Development and Execution
* PMO Setup \& Run
* Sustainable Templates and processes
* Dashboards and Automations


**Responsibilities, Skills, And Attributes For Success**
* Active listener, passionate learner with a creative and high\-performance mindset. Committed and driven towards helping and supporting the team in every aspect possible
* Having a successful and proven track record in some or all of below areas:
+ Business analysis
+ Transformation Management, Project Management, Change Management
+ Problem Solving, Design Thinking, root cause assessment
+ Process improvement, business improvement
+ Supporting cross\-functional teams

* Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills as a standard \- problem solving, critical thinking, conceptualizing, communication, leadership, presentation, workshop facilitation, storytelling, etc.
* Flexible, willing to work in hybrid model and open to support time zones
* Strong communication and presentation skills and be able to express yourself effectively, by breaking down complex structures into digestible and relevant points for a diverse set of clients and colleagues, at all levels
* Team player that collaborates well in a group setting to quickly and effectively accomplish tasks
* Flexibility in embracing and adapting to change
* Be able to strive in ambiguous environments and use analytical and creative thinking to find and develop innovative solutions to complex problems.
* Be curious and pay attention to detail, exercise active listening and be to anticipate and identify risks and escalate issues as appropriate
* Foster an innovative and inclusive team\-oriented work environment and demonstrate leadership by playing an active role in counselling and mentoring junior consultants within the organization
* Possess good business acumen and remain current on new developments in consulting capabilities and industry trends
* Demonstrate in\-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge.
* Develop and maintain long\-term client relationships and networks
* Develop and maintain relationships with team members across EY practices to serve client needs
* Cultivate and participate in business development opportunities. Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess/present ways to serve clients.
* Support planning activities for large, complex client programs
* Own tracking activities for key milestones and deliverables to ensure project stays on track according to plan
* Develop key reports and communicate relevant client insights


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree (BE \- B. Tech / MCA) and a minimum of 6\-9 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and a minimum of 4 years of related work experience
* Approximately 6\+ years’ experience on large scale complex programs providing consulting services in at least one of the following areas:
+ PMO/EPMO design/set up and delivery, program road\-mapping design, resource/capacity management, program execution
+ PMO maturity assessment, PMO Setup \& Operations
+ Transformation Office design/set up and delivery, Value/Benefit realization
+ End\-to End Portfolio Management implementation – intake and demand management, portfolio prioritization, portfolio selection, financial management
+ End\-to End ERP implementation

* Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills
* Flexible to work in US and UK time zones
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
* Knowledge of project and portfolio management (PPM) methodologies (Agile, Hybrid, SAFe, DevOps. etc.) and tools (Microsoft based tools such as Azure DevOps, MS Project Online, others such as Jira, Planview, Planisware, Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
* PPM certifications such as PMI, Prince2, Scrum Master, Scrum Product Owner, SAFe or equivalent are beneficial


**Good to have**
* MBA or relevant graduate degree is a plus
* Understanding of Agile concepts
* Business analysis skills
* Potential certifications include: PMP, Six Sigma, Scrum, Agile SAFe
* Sector experience in areas such as Automotive, Advanced Manufacturing \& Mobility, Consumer Products and Goods, Media and Entertainment, Life Sciences, and Consumer Products
* Experience supporting and participating in pursuit efforts. Experience with the end\-to\-end RFP process (RFP, Response, Proposal, Client Presentation, SOW and Execution) and understanding of client procurement processes
* Experience working in either of the following sector Pharma, Healthcare, Energy, Infrastructure, Oil and Gas, CPR or Technology.


**What We Look For**
 We look for people who can develop and implement creative solutions to challenging problems and work well with teams to accomplish it. We look for people with an entrepreneurial spirit: innovative by nature, always creating new approaches, products, services, and technologies. Helping clients solve tough problems and implement solutions requires strong intellectual abilities and rigor as well as a practical sense of what works and what does not. We seek people who strive to lead themselves, their teams, and their communities, and who can foster effective teamwork to drive results. Is this you? Read more…
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange.
   

  

**Plus, we offer:**
* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* Freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sizing Analyst
description:
**Department:** 
 Sales
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata / Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 10\-12 LPA
 



  





**About Triphos** 




 Triphos Power is a full\-stack battery\-as\-a\-service company focused on commercial and industrial (C\&I) customers. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform — the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company. We stream 650\+ Bengali movies, 185\+ originals, and 3000\+ hours of content to a global audience of \~250 million Bengalis across India, Bangladesh, and 100\+ countries. We're part of a wider ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI\-led micro\-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI\-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We're hiring a Senior Product Analyst to become the first dedicated owner of product analytics at hoichoi. We've been running PostHog for a few months, with real event data flowing across all platforms — what's missing is someone who digs into the data unprompted and turns it into a clear case for what we should change, and why. You'll sit inside the Product \& Data team and work closely with Engineering, Payments, and Programming to move two numbers: revenue and user experience.
 



  





 This is not a reporting service desk. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you will define how it works rather than inherit it. Your output is decisions, not dashboards — finding the exact step where a subscriber drops off, and owning a recommendation through to whether the number actually moved. We want someone who's done this before, checks the data before forming a view, and is comfortable reporting a flat result honestly. This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Kolkata.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Drop\-off Analysis** 



* Map every meaningful journey on every platform and find the exact step where users leave: onboarding, login and signup, search, content discovery, playback start, and the subscription funnel.
* Own the subscription funnel end to end — app open → paywall viewed → plan selected → payment initiated → payment success — split by platform, geography, and payment method.
* For every drop\-off found, report how many users and how much revenue it costs, why it's happening, and what specifically should change.
* Analyse payment failures and retry behaviour alongside the payments team.
* Track whether each recommended fix moved the number, and report plainly if it didn't.



**Retention, Churn \& Cohorts** 



* Build and maintain retention and cohort views — day\-1/7/30, trial\-to\-paid, renewal, and cancellation.
* Identify first\-session and first\-week behaviours that predict a subscriber sticking around, and recommend how to engineer more of them.



**Content \& Programming Analytics** 



* Report on content performance — tray impressions and clicks, play starts, completion rates, drop\-off curves, and search behaviour.
* Feed insights back to the programming team on what to promote, tray order, and whether an underperforming release was a content or merchandising issue.
* Support the internal Programming Analyst tooling built on top of PostHog.



**Experimentation** 



* Set up and read A/B tests and feature\-flag rollouts in PostHog — paywall variants, onboarding flows, tray layouts.
* Define success metrics and guardrail metrics up front, and call results honestly, including flat ones.



**Reporting Rhythm** 



* Run a weekly product metrics review that people actually read, and a monthly deep dive on one problem area of your choosing.
* Deliver release\-impact analysis after every major app release.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications :** 



* 4–6 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data analysis on a consumer (B2C) product — app or web — including experience mentoring or setting standards for others.
* Hands\-on ownership of a product analytics tool (PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or similar) — has defined events, built funnels, and debugged bad data, not just consumed dashboards someone else built.
* Demonstrated ability to find drop\-offs and act on them, with a concrete example of a funnel fixed, what was found, what changed, and what it was worth.
* Solid grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention curves, and segmentation.
* Comfortable working with AI tooling day to day — specifically the PostHog MCP server with Claude — and able to get MCP running within a week if new to it.
* Willing to check the data and then take a decision: form a view, recommend it clearly, and own the outcome.
* Able to write a clear recommendation — what the data says, what to do about it, and how confident to be.
* Self\-directed, arriving with questions rather than waiting for answers.



  





  





**Candidates must have experience in any product analytics tool: PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap or similar.** 




  





**Why Join hoichoi** 




 You'll be the first dedicated product analytics hire at India's leading Bengali OTT platform — defining how the function works rather than inheriting someone else's playbook, with real event data across six platforms from day one. Every recommendation you make has a direct line to revenue and to how millions of viewers experience the product. hoichoi is going all\-in on becoming AI\-native, so you'll work daily with the PostHog MCP server and Claude as part of your core workflow, with a clear path to owning a growing analytics function as it scales.
 



  





**Culture \& How We Work** 




 At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross\-functional teams that argue productively and ship fast. Ownership isn't a buzzword here; it's the default setting — if something's broken, you fix it rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
 



  





 We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Some releases — particularly TV platform and store submissions — land outside standard hours, and we expect flexibility around those windows. We're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable the rest of the time.

title: EYP-DME-Associate Manager

**Associate Manager – Business Modelling**
 As part of our EY\-Valuation, Modelling and Economics team, you will help clients understand the value of their business, securities, intellectual property, capital equipment, intangibles and other assets. The group is comprised of several key areas, including business valuation, business modelling, capital equipment and complex securities.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are looking for Associate Manager with expertise in Business Modelling to join EY\-VME (Valuation, Modelling and Economics). Over the past decade, financial modelling in the corporate finance space has continued to grow at a healthy space. Our Business Modelling group helps create social and economic value for our clients by helping them make more informed steps about strategically managing capital and transactions. In short, we help clients with their corporate finance modelling steps using traditional as well as newer technologies to meet client’s needs.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

 The successful candidate must be committed to staying at the cutting edge of both, latest derivative valuation techniques and the financial and accounting standards that guide the use of these techniques.
   

  

**What We Look For**

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

title: Market Access Manager
description:
**Department** 
 : Rare Disease \& Public Care
   

  

**Location** 
 : Kolkata
   

  

**Company: Novo Nordisk India Pvt. Ltd**
**Your impact begins here**
 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.


**Useful, But Not Essential**
* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.


**What You'll Do**
* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.
   

  

 Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.
   

  

 The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.
   

  

**What You Can Expect Here**
 You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.
   

  

**Start now**
 Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
